title: Sinfonia
subtitle: The overture to Così fan tutte, in Kurt Soldan's piano reduction

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Sinfonia (overture; “Ouvertura” in this score)
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Piano reduction by Kurt Soldan in the Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 1–6, 261 bars
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946)
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: each page range read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, slurs and other marks, then checked bar by bar by fresh checkers (clean). The editorial [f] in bar 1 is entered as a plain f; grace notes as sixteenths. Instrument cues (G. Orch., Ob., Fl., Str., Pk., Bässe…) are left out. Playback tempo from the lengths of four complete recordings (Jacobs, Muti, Cantelli, Böhm; median about 4:28): Andante at ♩ = 67, Presto at a half note = 136 (♩ = 272); Mozart gives the words only.
